WITH matched_counts AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
),
scored AS (
  SELECT translink, ordertypedist, matched_count,
         CAST(matched_count AS REAL) / SUM(matched_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction
  FROM matched_counts
)
SELECT translink, ordertypedist, matched_count, fraction
FROM scored
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
